title: Lamb – Whole Roasted Rack
ingredients: But All the Other Ingredients for 2 Racks
1 (2-3 pound) frenched rack of lamb, otherwise not trimmed of all the fat, etc.
6 ounces creamy goat cheesy, at room temperature
1/4 cup crème fraîche or plain greek yogurt, at room temperature
directions: From Tieghan Gerard: For whatever reason, I have feared cooking a whole rack of lamb for the longest time. I finally decided to make a roasted rack of lamb as the centerpiece of my Easter menu. And you guys, this is not just any rack of lamb, it’s one that I love! I also added a goat cheese sauce that’s incredible, basically whipped goat cheese with a touch of honey and fresh basil.
On a large, rimmed baking sheet, season the racks generously with salt and pepper.

In a food processor, combine the olive oil, garlic, oregano, cumin seeds, lemon zest, and crushed red pepper flakes. Pulse until combined. Rub the mixture evenly over both racks. Arrange the carrots around the lamb. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes to 1 hour or cover and place in the fridge overnight.
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F.
Roast the lamb for 10 minutes, then flip and roast another 5-15 minutes for medium-rare (125 degrees). Remove and let stand 10 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile, make the sauce. In blender, combine the goat cheese, crème fraîche, honey, and basil or mint until smooth. Stir in the lemons zest and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Slice the lamb in between the bones and serve with the goat cheese sauce.
